My Town (Hollywood Undead song) | "My Town" is a song by American rap rock band Hollywood Undead, the fifth single from their second full-length album, "American Tragedy", and the fourth track on that album. Bullet for My Valentine discography | The discography of Bullet for My Valentine, a Welsh heavy metal band, is composed of five studio albums and five EPs, from which eighteen singles and seventeen music videos have been released. Burn My Eyes | Burn My Eyes is the debut studio album by American groove metal band Machine Head, released on August 9, 1994 by Roadrunner Records. The album shipped over 400,000 copies worldwide, becoming Roadrunner Records's best selling debut album until the release of Slipknot's debut album. 
My Name Is Jonas | "My Name Is Jonas" is a song by alternative rock band Weezer.  It is the first track of the band's self-titled 1994 debut album, also known as "The Blue Album". King and Lionheart | "King and Lionheart" is a song recorded by Icelandic alternative folk band Of Monsters and Men, written by co-lead vocalist Nanna Bryndís Hilmarsdóttir and produced by the band with Aron Arnarsson and Jacquire King for the band's debut studio album, "My Head Is an Animal". Useless Animal | Useless Animal is an extended play by the American rock band Cult Leader. Hug My Soul | "Hug My Soul" is a single by British band Saint Etienne.  It was the third single from the album "Tiger Bay", and was released  1994 (1994-) by Heavenly Records. Selfless (album) | Selfless is the third studio album by British industrial metal band Godflesh. Heads Are Gonna Roll | Heads Are Gonna Roll is the second album by the Los Angeles, California ska band The Hippos, released in 1999 by Interscope Records. Sending My Love | "Sending My Love" is a song by American R&B group Zhané recorded for their debut album "Pronounced Jah-Nay" (1994).  The song was released as the album's third single in May 1994.
